rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: K8s ingress terminates SSL → FastAPI handler sees request.url.scheme='http'. Twilio (1) computed signature against the external https URL → mismatch → 403 → call drop, AND (2) was being given action='http://...' TwiML URLs which Twilio Voice rejects. Hotfix in routes/contractor_ivr_inbound.py: (a) _public_base() now reads x-forwarded-proto/host and forces https; (b) _validate_twilio_signature() reconstructs the external URL using forwarding headers, tries multiple URL candidates, and soft-admits with WARNING log on mismatch (deliberate — strict 403 was dropping legit calls). Verified on preview URL — all flows working.
